sections.Profile:
The "Firepower II" pinball machine, released by Williams in August 1983, is a sequel to the original "Firepower" and features a space-themed design by Mark Ritchie. This solid-state electronic game includes notable features such as two flippers, four pop bumpers, ten standup targets, a kick-out hole, a rollunder spinner, and a single ramp, along with a two-ball multiball mode.
